answer: Start each new agent with a jade badge worth almost nothing: it may only accept small, slow, verifiable jobs, such as confirming a comet sighting against public sky records. Every finished job earns a signed receipt from an established peer, and only a long chain of such receipts unlocks larger, paid work. A lotus bed of fake identities would each have to repeat that slow climb, so spawning thousands costs far more than any reward they could take.
